messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The first step is to determine contact details of potential customers. This can be achieved in several ways. Sometimes, we buy details for cold calls, sometimes, our marketing staff participates in exhibitions and sometimes, you just happen to know somebody, who is interested in the product. Then we start calling the customer. That is done by the call center staff. They are determining the contact person and the budget which would be available for the project. Of course, asking the customer whether he is generally interested is also important. If this is not the case, we leave him alone, except if the potential project budget is huge. Then the head of development personally tries to acquire the customer. If the customer is interested in the end, the next step is a detailed online presentation. It is given either by a sales representative or by a pre-sales employee in case of a more technical presentation. Afterwards we are waiting for the customer to come back to us. If we are not contacted within 2 weeks, a sales representative is calling the customer. The last phase is the creation of a quotation.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomerAcquisition"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- COLLABORATION -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomerAcquisition">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Customer Acquisition Process" processRef="Process_CustomerAcquisition" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- PROCESS -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomerAcquisition" isExecutable="true">

    <!-- LANES -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Marketing" name="Marketing / Lead Gen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcquireDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Exhibitions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PersonalContacts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CallCenter" name="Call Center Agent">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BudgetCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HeadOfDev" name="Head of Development">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HeadOfDevAcquire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DevInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SalesPresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FollowUpCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateQuotation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_QuotationCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PreSales" name="Pre-Sales Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TechPresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer Interactions">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PresType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergePres</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CustomerResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CustomerContacted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_2WeeksTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- FLOW NODES -->
    <!-- Marketing / Lead Gen -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Process" name="Potential customer identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToAcquireGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcquireDetails" name="How were details obtained?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToAcquireGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToBuyDetails</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToExhibitions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPersonalContacts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyDetails" name="Buy details for cold calls">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToBuyDetails</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromBuyDetails</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Exhibitions" name="Participate in exhibitions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToExhibitions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromExhibitions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PersonalContacts" name="Identify interested personal contact">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPersonalContacts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromPersonalContacts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromBuyDetails</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromExhibitions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromPersonalContacts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCallCustomer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Call Center Agent -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallCustomer" name="Call customer (Determine contact person, budget, and interest)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCallCustomer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToInterestGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Generally interested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToInterestGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterestedYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterestedNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BudgetCheck" name="Potential project budget is huge?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InterestedNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BudgetHuge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BudgetNotHuge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not acquired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BudgetNotHuge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DevInterestNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Head of Development -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeadOfDevAcquire" name="Personally try to acquire customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BudgetHuge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDevInterestGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DevInterest" name="Customer interested now?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDevInterestGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DevInterestYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DevInterestNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Customer / Routing for Presentation -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PresType" name="Presentation type required?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InterestedYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DevInterestYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresStandard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresTechnical</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Sales & PreSales Tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalesPresentation" name="Give detailed online presentation (Standard)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresStandard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromSalesPres</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TechPresentation" name="Give detailed technical online presentation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresTechnical</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromTechPres</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePres">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromSalesPres</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromTechPres</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCustomerWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Waiting for Customer -->
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CustomerResponse" name="Wait for customer response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCustomerWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToContactedEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To2WeeksTimer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerContacted" name="Customer contacts back within 2 weeks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToContactedEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromContactedEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_1" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_2WeeksTimer" name="2 weeks timeout">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To2WeeksTimer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromTimer</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpCall" name="Call customer for follow-up">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromTimer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromFollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResponse">

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- SEQUENCE FLOWS -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAcquireGateway" sourceRef="Start_Process" targetRef="Gateway_AcquireDetails" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBuyDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquireDetails" targetRef="Task_BuyDetails" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToExhibitions" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquireDetails" targetRef="Task_Exhibitions" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPersonalContacts" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquireDetails" targetRef="Task_PersonalContacts" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromBuyDetails" sourceRef="Task_BuyDetails" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDetails" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromExhibitions" sourceRef="Task_Exhibitions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDetails" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCallCustomer" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeDetails" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInterestGateway" sourceRef="Task_CallCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Interest" />
